content:
# Terms & Conditions

Last Updated: [Insert Date]

Welcome to Ping – Connect More.

These Terms & Conditions govern your access to and use of the Ping application, website and related services ("Ping", "we", "us" or "our").

By creating an account, accessing or using Ping, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use Ping.

## 1. About Ping

Ping is a communication and digital interaction platform that may provide features including messaging, voice and video calls, email-related functionality, photo and video sharing, short-form videos, communities, channels, content discovery and shopping or price-discovery features.

Features may vary by region, account type, device and availability.

## 2. Eligibility

You must provide accurate information when creating an account.

You are responsible for ensuring that your use of Ping complies with applicable laws and regulations.

If a particular feature has an age requirement, you must meet that requirement before using the feature.

## 3. Your Account

You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and authentication information.

You must not:

• Share your password or authentication credentials with unauthorized persons
• Impersonate another person or organization
• Create accounts for fraudulent or abusive purposes
• Use another person's account without authorization
• Attempt to bypass account restrictions

You are responsible for activity performed through your account unless caused by circumstances outside your reasonable control.

## 4. User Content

Ping allows users to create, upload, send and share content.

You retain ownership of content that you legally own.

By submitting content to Ping, you grant Ping the permissions necessary to host, store, process, transmit, display and distribute that content as required to operate the relevant Ping features.

You must have the rights and permissions necessary to submit the content.

## 5. Prohibited Use

You must not use Ping to:

• Commit or facilitate illegal activities
• Harass, threaten or abuse others
• Distribute malware or malicious links
• Conduct fraud or phishing
• Infringe intellectual property rights
• Distribute prohibited sexual or exploitative content
• Exploit or endanger children
• Circumvent security controls
• Manipulate or abuse platform systems
• Send spam or unwanted communications

Additional content requirements are described in our Content Policy & Community Guidelines.

## 6. Calls and Communications

Users are responsible for their communications through Ping.

Do not use calls, messages or other communication features for harassment, fraud, threats, unauthorized recording or other unlawful activity.

## 7. Content Moderation

Ping may use automated systems, user reports and human review to identify content or activity that violates our policies.

We may remove content, restrict features, suspend accounts or terminate accounts where appropriate.

## 8. Third-Party Services

Some Ping features may depend on third-party services, integrations or external platforms.

Third-party services may have their own terms and privacy policies.

Ping is not responsible for services that are independently operated by third parties.

## 9. Shopping and Product Information

Where Ping provides product discovery or price-comparison functionality, information may come from third-party sources.

Prices, availability, product descriptions and offers may change.

Ping does not guarantee that third-party information is complete, accurate or continuously available.

## 10. Intellectual Property

Ping's software, branding, interface, logos and original materials are owned by Ping or its licensors unless otherwise stated.

You may not copy, modify, distribute or commercially exploit Ping's proprietary materials without appropriate authorization.

## 11. Service Availability

Ping may change, suspend or discontinue features or services from time to time.

We do not guarantee that every feature will always be available, uninterrupted or error-free.

## 12. Account Suspension and Termination

Ping may restrict or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, our policies, applicable law or create risks to users or the platform.

Where appropriate, users may be provided with an opportunity to appeal an enforcement decision.

## 13. Disclaimers

Ping is provided subject to applicable law and available functionality.

We do not guarantee that content provided by users or third parties is accurate, reliable or appropriate.

## 14. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Ping and its operators will not be responsible for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses arising from use of the service.

Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded.

## 15. Changes

We may update these Terms as Ping develops and as legal or regulatory requirements change.

Updated terms will be published through Ping or our website.

## 16. Contact

title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How PingDart protects, encrypts, and handles your personal information
content:
PRIVACY POLICY

Effective Date: September 26, 2026

Ping – Connect More (“Ping”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we may collect, use, process, store, and protect information when you use the Ping mobile application and related services.

By using Ping, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

1. INFORMATION WE MAY COLLECT

Depending on the features you use, Ping may collect the following categories of information.

ACCOUNT INFORMATION

This may include:
- Name
- Email address
- Phone number
- Profile information
- Login and authentication information

COMMUNICATION INFORMATION

When you use communication features, information may include:
- Messages
- Group conversations
- Photos
- Videos
- Shared media
- Call-related information

USER-GENERATED CONTENT

You may voluntarily provide:
- Profile photos
- Posts
- Reels
- Comments
- Community content
- Channel content
- Photos and videos
- Other content you choose to upload or share

DEVICE AND TECHNICAL INFORMATION

We may collect information necessary to operate and secure Ping, including:
- Device type
- Operating system
- App version
- IP address
- Network information
- Crash information
- Diagnostic information
- Security and fraud-prevention information

2. HOW WE USE INFORMATION

We may use information to:
- Create and manage your account.
- Provide chat and messaging services.
- Enable voice and video calls.
- Provide email-related functionality.
- Store and display user-generated content.
- Provide reels, communities, and channel features.
- Personalize your experience.
- Provide content discovery.
- Provide product discovery and price-comparison functionality.
- Improve application performance.
- Detect fraud, spam, abuse, and unauthorized activity.
- Protect the security of users and the Service.
- Troubleshoot technical problems.
- Develop and improve Ping.
- Send important service-related communications.

3. MESSAGES AND USER CONTENT

Ping processes information that is necessary to provide communication and content-sharing features.

Depending on the specific feature and technical implementation, messages and other content may be stored on Ping's systems or processed through service providers that help operate the application.

Users should avoid sharing passwords, financial credentials, government identification numbers, or other highly sensitive information through ordinary chats unless a specific Ping feature requires such information.

4. DEVICE PERMISSIONS

Ping may request device permissions when required for particular features.

CAMERA

The camera may be required for taking photos, recording videos, or participating in video calls.

MICROPHONE

The microphone may be required for voice calls, video calls, or recording audio.

PHOTOS AND MEDIA

Access may be required when you choose to upload or share photos and videos.

NOTIFICATIONS

Notifications may be used to inform you about messages, calls, account activity, and important service updates.

You can manage available permissions through your device settings. Disabling certain permissions may prevent related features from working correctly.

5. LOCATION INFORMATION

Ping does not require precise location information for its basic communication features.

If a feature requires location information, Ping may request the relevant permission where required and use location information only for the applicable feature.

6. COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES

Ping and its service providers may use cookies, identifiers, SDKs, or similar technologies where applicable to:
- Maintain sessions.
- Remember preferences.
- Improve application performance.
- Understand application usage.
- Detect security issues.
- Improve user experience.

7. THIRD-PARTY SERVICE PROVIDERS

Ping may use third-party service providers to help operate the application.

These providers may support services such as:
- Cloud hosting
- Authentication
- Database infrastructure
- Analytics
- Notifications
- Security
- Content delivery
- Communication services
- Payment or commerce-related functionality, where applicable

Third-party providers may process information as necessary to provide services to Ping and in accordance with applicable agreements and laws.

8. SHOPPING AND EXTERNAL SERVICES

Ping may display product information, prices, availability, offers, or links obtained from third-party sources.

When you interact with a third-party website, seller, application, or service, that third party may collect and process information according to its own privacy policy.

Ping does not control the privacy practices of independent third parties.

9. DATA SECURITY

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

However, no internet-based service can guarantee absolute security.

You are also responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials and device.

10. DATA RETENTION

We may retain information for as long as reasonably necessary to:
- Provide the Service.
- Maintain user accounts.
- Provide requested features.
- Meet legal and regulatory obligations.
- Resolve disputes.
- Prevent fraud and abuse.
- Enforce our agreements.
- Maintain security.
- Maintain necessary operational records.

Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and the purpose for which it is processed.

11. YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS AND CHOICES

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including:
- Requesting access to certain personal information.
- Requesting correction of inaccurate information.
- Requesting deletion of certain information.
- Withdrawing certain permissions.
- Requesting information about data processing.
- Objecting to or restricting certain processing where legally available.

You can also manage certain permissions through your device settings.

12. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY

Ping is not intended for children where use is prohibited by applicable law.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable legal requirements.

If you believe that a child has provided personal information to Ping improperly, please contact us so that we can review the situation and take appropriate action.

13. INTERNATIONAL DATA PROCESSING

Depending on our infrastructure and service providers, information may be processed or stored in countries other than the country where you live.

Where required by applicable law, appropriate safeguards may be used for international data transfers.

14. CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our services, technology, or legal requirements.

The updated Privacy Policy may be made available through the Ping application or other appropriate channels.

15. CONTACT US

If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact us using the support or privacy contact information provided within the Ping application or through our official support channels.

By using Ping – Connect More, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

title: Content Policy & Community Guidelines
subtitle: Guidelines for creating, sharing, discovering and interacting with content on Ping.
content:
# Content Policy & Community Guidelines

Ping is a platform for communication, content sharing, communities and digital interaction. Users may create, upload, share and interact with messages, photos, videos, reels, posts, comments, channels and other content.

These Content Policy & Community Guidelines explain what content and behavior is permitted on Ping and what actions may be taken when these rules are violated.

By creating or uploading content on Ping, you agree to follow these guidelines and our Terms & Conditions.

## 1. Content You Can Share

Users may share appropriate and lawful content including:

• Text posts and updates
• Photos and images
• Short videos and reels
• Comments and replies
• Messages and conversations
• Community posts
• Channel content
• Educational and informational content
• Creative and entertainment content
• Links and other supported media

You are responsible for the content you create, upload or share.

## 2. Respectful Communication

Ping is intended to provide a safe and respectful environment.

Do not use Ping to:

• Harass, threaten or intimidate others
• Bully or repeatedly target another person
• Encourage violence or physical harm
• Promote hatred against individuals or protected groups
• Publish humiliating or abusive content targeting another person
• Impersonate another person or organization
• Encourage coordinated abuse or harassment

## 3. Reels, Short Videos & Video Content

Ping may provide features for discovering, uploading and sharing short-form videos and reels.

Video content must comply with these guidelines.

Do not upload or share:

• Violent or graphic content intended to shock or disturb
• Sexually explicit or pornographic videos
• Content involving sexual exploitation or abuse of minors
• Dangerous challenges or activities that encourage serious harm
• Content promoting illegal activities
• Content intended to harass, threaten or humiliate another person
• Misleading or deceptive content intended to cause harm

Users should only upload videos that they have the legal right to share.

## 4. Photos, Images & Media

Users may share photos, images and other supported media.

You must not upload content that:

• Violates another person's privacy
• Contains illegal material
• Exploits or endangers children
• Contains non-consensual intimate material
• Infringes copyright or other intellectual property rights
• Is intended to threaten, harass or abuse another person

## 5. Adult & Sexual Content

Ping does not allow pornography or content primarily intended to provide sexual gratification.

Sexually explicit content, sexual solicitation, exploitation and content involving minors are prohibited.

Illegal sexual content and child sexual exploitation material are strictly prohibited and may be removed immediately and reported to appropriate authorities where required by law.

Ping may apply additional restrictions, filtering or age-related controls to sensitive content.

## 6. Child Safety

Content involving the sexual exploitation or abuse of children is strictly prohibited.

Users must not create, upload, request, share, promote or distribute child sexual abuse material or other content that exploits or endangers minors.

Any suspected child exploitation content may be removed immediately and may be reported to appropriate authorities as required by applicable law.

## 7. Violence & Dangerous Activities

Do not use Ping to promote or encourage:

• Terrorism or violent extremism
• Serious physical violence
• Self-harm or suicide
• Dangerous activities that could cause serious injury
• Instructions intended to facilitate serious illegal harm

Educational, documentary or news-related content may be treated differently depending on context, but users remain responsible for complying with applicable laws and Ping policies.

## 8. Illegal Activities

Ping must not be used to facilitate or promote illegal activities.

This includes content involving illegal drugs, fraud, trafficking, exploitation, unauthorized access to accounts or systems, or other unlawful activities.

## 9. Spam, Scams & Deceptive Content

Do not use Ping to distribute:

• Spam
• Phishing attempts
• Fake giveaways
• Fraudulent offers
• Malware or malicious links
• Fake accounts created for deception
• Misleading advertisements
• Repeated unwanted promotional content

Automated or coordinated activity designed to manipulate engagement may also be restricted.

## 10. Copyright & Intellectual Property

Only upload or share content that you have permission to use.

Do not upload copyrighted videos, music, photographs, logos, articles or other protected material without appropriate authorization.

Ping may remove content when it receives a valid intellectual property complaint or when content violates applicable law or platform policies.

## 11. Privacy & Personal Information

Do not publicly share another person's private or sensitive information without permission.

This may include:

• Phone numbers
• Private email addresses
• Home addresses
• Passwords
• Financial information
• Private conversations
• Identification documents
• Private photographs or videos

Users should also avoid sharing their own sensitive information publicly.

## 12. Impersonation & Misrepresentation

Do not create accounts or content intended to falsely represent another person, company, organization or public figure.

Parody, commentary and clearly identified fan accounts may be permitted where they do not intentionally deceive users.

## 13. Communities & Channels

Community and channel administrators are responsible for helping maintain a safe environment.

Administrators may establish additional rules for their communities, provided those rules do not conflict with Ping's policies or applicable law.

Ping may take action when communities or channels are repeatedly used to distribute prohibited content.

## 14. Comments & Interactions

Comments, replies, reactions and other interactions must follow these guidelines.

Constructive disagreement is allowed. Harassment, threats, hate, spam and targeted abuse are not.

## 15. Shopping & Shared Product Content

Users may share product information, recommendations or shopping-related content where supported.

Do not use shopping features to promote fraudulent products, illegal goods, deceptive offers or misleading claims.

Product prices, availability and third-party information may change and may not always be controlled by Ping.

## 16. AI-Generated Content

If Ping provides AI-assisted content creation features, users remain responsible for the content they generate or share.

AI-generated content must not be used to create or distribute prohibited, illegal, deceptive or harmful material.

Users should not use AI tools to impersonate people, create non-consensual intimate content, exploit minors or facilitate harmful activities.

## 17. Reporting Content

If you believe content violates these guidelines, you should use the in-app reporting functionality where available.

Reports may be reviewed to determine whether content or accounts violate Ping's policies.

Depending on the situation, Ping may remove content, restrict visibility, limit account functionality, suspend an account or permanently terminate an account.

## 18. Blocking Users

Ping provides blocking functionality for supported user interactions.

Blocking a user can prevent or limit further interactions with that user depending on the feature and implementation.

Users should use blocking and reporting tools when they encounter abusive or unwanted interactions.

## 19. Content Moderation

Ping may use automated systems, user reports and human review to identify and address content that violates these guidelines.

Moderation actions may include:

• Removing content
• Limiting content visibility
• Restricting recommendations
• Removing accounts
• Suspending accounts
• Permanently terminating accounts
• Restricting specific features

We may take action without prior notice where necessary to protect users, comply with law or address serious violations.

## 20. Appeals

Where an account or content is restricted or removed, Ping may provide an appeal or review process where appropriate.

Users may be asked to provide additional information so that the decision can be reviewed.

## 21. Repeated Violations

Repeated or serious violations may result in stronger enforcement actions, including permanent account termination.

Attempts to evade restrictions by creating new accounts may also result in additional restrictions.

## 22. Changes to These Guidelines

Ping may update these Content Policy & Community Guidelines as the platform, features, laws and safety requirements evolve.

Updated versions may be published on this page and may become effective when posted unless otherwise stated.

## 23. Contact & Safety Reports

If you need to report serious abuse, illegal content, safety concerns or violations that cannot be reported through the app, use the official support or reporting channel provided by Ping.

Please provide enough information for the issue to be reviewed, including relevant usernames, content references or screenshots where appropriate.

## Final Note

Ping is designed to support communication, creativity, discovery and community interaction.

By using Ping, you agree to help maintain a safe and respectful environment and to follow these Content Policy & Community Guidelines, our Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy and applicable laws.

# Cookie & Tracking Policy

This policy explains how Ping may use cookies and similar technologies on its websites and web-based services.

## 1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small data files stored on a device that can help websites remember information about a user or session.

## 2. Why We Use Cookies

Cookies or similar technologies may be used for:

• Authentication
• Security
• User preferences
• Session management
• Analytics
• Performance monitoring
• Service functionality

## 3. Third-Party Technologies

Some third-party services may use their own cookies or similar technologies according to their own policies.

## 4. Managing Cookies

Depending on your browser or device, you may be able to control or remove cookies through browser settings.

Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

## 5. Updates

We may update this policy when our technologies or legal requirements change.

Third-party sellers and platforms may have their own terms, policies, warranties and refund procedures.
